human.name: Human
human.desc: They are a terrestrial race with highly versatile combat skills. While they lack the innate power of other races, they are incredibly resourceful and tenacious. They stand out for their perseverance and courage, able to overcome their limitations through training and discipline.

berserker.name: Berserker
berserker.passive_desc: Below 66% HP you gain 25% HP regen and 10% crit chance. Below 33% HP this rises to 75% HP regen and 25% crit chance.

cleric.name: Cleric
cleric.passive_desc: Healing Ki attacks have 20% reduced cooldown. Those that also grant an ally buff get 15% reduced cooldown instead, but the buff lasts 25% longer.

martialartist.name: Martial Artist
martialartist.passive_desc: Strike attacks deal up to 25% more damage based on the target's missing health (no bonus above 75% HP, full bonus at or below 25% HP).

paladin.name: Paladin
paladin.passive_desc: 15% of the damage your party members take is redirected to you. You heal for 15% of the damage your party members deal.

spiritualist.name: Spiritualist
spiritualist.passive_desc: Damaging Ki attacks have 20% reduced cooldown. Those that also apply a debuff get 15% reduced cooldown instead, but the debuff lasts 25% longer.

tank.name: Tank
tank.passive_desc: 50% of your stamina regen is granted as bonus HP regen (not a conversion). Healing you receive (passive or ally skills, not from eating) is 25% more effective. Below 30% HP both bonuses are doubled.

warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.passive_desc: Landing 3 melee hits in a row (each connecting, none blocked) grants a Fury stack, up to 5. Each stack increases STM regen by 10%; at 5 stacks you also gain 10% defense penetration. Stacks refresh when you deal damage and fade if you stop.

saiyan.name: Saiyan
saiyan.desc: They are a warrior race born for combat. Their innate ability to grow stronger after each battle makes them formidable opponents. They can even transform into powerful Super Saiyans and take their abilities to unimaginable levels.

namekian.desc: They are a peaceful yet powerful race, with great regenerative abilities and a natural connection to magic and nature. They are known for their wisdom, energy control, and their ability to fuse with others of their kind, increasing their power.
